library(tidyverse)

```{r}
ratio_table <- read_csv("./density_graph_ratio.csv")
ratio_table <- tibble::rowid_to_column(ratio_table, "index")
ratio_long <- pivot_longer(ratio_table, !index, names_to = "sets", values_to = "ratio")
```
```{r}
graph <- ggplot(ratio_long, aes(x = ratio, fill = sets)) +
  geom_density(position = 'identity', alpha = 0.8, adjust = 1) +
  theme_bw()
graph
ggsave("NPKL_SAD_genes_ratio.pdf")
```
